TERMINAL.Migration.Intro:
Terminal is moving from IDs to UUIDs. This will require converting the Terminal data seen below.
This process is automated but it's recommended to check for errors and if you have any issues message CodaBool by searching in the Foundry Discord.
TERMINAL.Migration.WhyText: UUIDs are more robust in that they include the scene ID. This allows for using the Secure Shell or Unlocking doors in separate scenes than what is currently viewed. Additionally UUIDs are now what Foundry V12+ uses by default.
TERMINAL.Migration.Complete: {count} tiles migrated. You may close this window at any time. Manually verify that SSH, doors, and journals work as expected.
